swahili: Shares the name with Digo (Pakia App. VI, as chilishangwe)

teaser.en: A milky-sapped relative of the shea tree, hidden in the coastal thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa mti wa shea mwenye utomvu kama maziwa, aliyejificha katika vichaka vya pwani vya Kenya na Tanzania.

summary.en: Mkilishangwe is a shrub or small tree of the milkwood family, found in coastal thicket and forest. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem.
summary.sw: Mkilishangwe ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae (milkwood), unaopatikana katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake.

about.en:
*Mkilishangwe* is a shrub or small tree of the Sapotaceae, the family of the shea tree and the milkwoods. Like its relatives it has white, milky latex in its bark and leaves. The leaves are simple, leathery and clustered towards the ends of the twigs.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem.
about.sw:
*Mkilishangwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae, familia ya mti wa shea na ya *milkwoods*. Kama jamaa zake, una utomvu mweupe kama maziwa katika gome na majani yake. Majani ni sahili, magumu kama ngozi na yamejikusanya kuelekea ncha za vijiti.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake.

where.en: It is a plant of the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania, part of the band of dry coastal forest that includes the kaya forests of Kwale.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani vya Kenya na Tanzania, sehemu ya ukanda wa misitu mikavu ya pwani unaojumuisha misitu ya kaya ya Kwale.

names.en: Pakia's word list gives *mkilishangwe*, while his notes on name meanings give *chilishangwe*, and say that Duruma and Swahili share the name. No meaning is given, and there is no English name.
names.sw: Orodha ya maneno ya Pakia inatoa *mkilishangwe*, wakati maelezo yake kuhusu maana za majina yanatoa *chilishangwe*, na kusema kwamba Kiduruma na Kiswahili hushiriki jina hilo. Hakuna maana inayotolewa, na hakuna jina la Kiingereza.

conservation.en: It grows only in the East African coastal forests, which are shrinking as land is cleared.
conservation.sw: Hukua tu katika misitu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, ambayo inapungua kadiri ardhi inavyosafishwa.

reason.en: Inhambanella, Sapotaceae of the coastal forest
reason.sw: Inhambanella, Sapotaceae ya misitu ya pwani
Manilkara (mnago), mti wa familia ya Sapotaceae
